SI-Ratio Plot (Interactive)

Source: R/plotSiRatiosHc.R
plotSiRatiosHc.Rd

Interactive visualization of SI-ratios and seasonal factors by period using highcharter. Supports zoom, pan, and hover tooltips for exploratory analysis. For static plots suitable for publications, see plotSiRatiosGgplot.

Usage

plotSiRatiosHc(x)

Arguments

x

An object of class persephone

Value

An object of class highchart

Details

For x13Single objects, displays SI-ratios, replaced SI-ratios, seasonal factors, and their mean. For tramoseatsSingle objects, shows SI-ratios and their mean.

Examples

x <- perX13(AirPassengers)
x$run()
plotSiRatiosHc(x)
